issues: The predicted-outcome field causally attributes improved MOR performance to the larger active area and multielement framework, whereas the paper reports these features without firmly establishing that causal explanation.

The actual-result field compresses the noble-metal-free control result: NiCoCuFe remained unreduced at 300°C and only formed a phase-separated alloy at 450°C, rather than simply segregating under the standard 300°C condition.
